members.name: Lennox Head
members.bio: Surf village with Lennox Point's long right-hand break and the Pat Morton lookout over Seven Mile Beach.

members.name: Seven Mile Beach
members.bio: Beach stretching from Lennox Head towards Broken Head, popular for body surfing and kite surfing.
members.photo_file: Seven Mile Beach and Lennox Head.jpg

members.name: Lake Ainsworth
members.bio: Tea-tree-stained dune lake beside Lennox Head, with sheltered water for beginner windsurfers.

members.name: The Big Prawn
members.bio: Giant concrete and fibreglass prawn on a stand beside the Bunnings car park entrance in Ballina.
members.photo_file: The Big Prawn Bunnings Ballina NSW L1010612.jpg

members.name: Lighthouse Beach
members.bio: Patrolled East Ballina beach, 600 m long, between Shelly Beach and the North Wall.

members.name: Murwillumbah
members.bio: Tweed River valley town among cane and banana farms, with a rainforest visitor centre and Wollumbin nearby.

members.name: Wollumbin National Park
members.bio: Short Lyrebird rainforest walk at the foot of Wollumbin (Mount Warning), whose summit track is closed.
members.hours: Gate 7:00 AM – 5:00 PM (6:00 PM in summer)
members.photo_file: Mt Warning as seen from Pinnacle Lookout in the NSW Border Ranges.jpg

members.name: Fingal Head
members.bio: Basalt headland with a seven-metre 1878 lighthouse and columns once called the Giants Causeway.
members.photo_file: Fingal Head Lighthouse, Fingal Head, New South Wales 05.jpg

members.name: Tweed Regional Gallery
members.bio: Free gallery in Murwillumbah with the Margaret Olley Art Centre, a recreation of her Sydney workspace.

members.name: Cabarita Beach
members.bio: Surf beach town on the Tweed coast, with Norries Headland and a popular surf spot north of it.

members.name: Tropical Fruit World
members.bio: Duranbah farm with a free marketplace and tractor-train tours through more than 550 fruit varieties.

members.name: Nimbin
members.bio: Counterculture village since the 1973 Aquarius Festival, lined with alternative shops, cafes and a Hemp Museum.

members.name: Nightcap National Park
members.bio: World Heritage rainforest park, created in 1983 after logging blockades at Terania Creek.
members.hours: Open daily; check NPWS alerts (road closures)
members.photo_file: Terania Rapids in Nightcap National Park, NSW (35363169706).jpg

members.name: Minyon Falls
members.bio: Lookout over a waterfall plunging more than 100 m over rhyolite cliffs of the old Tweed Volcano.

members.name: Lismore Regional Gallery
members.bio: Free Rural Street gallery hosting exhibitions by local and well-known artists, open late on Thursdays.

members.name: Angourie Point
members.bio: Surf point south of Yamba in a National Surfing Reserve, near the freshwater Angourie Pools.

members.name: Maclean
members.bio: Clarence River town billed as 'The Scottish Town', with Gaelic street signs and tartan-painted power poles.
members.photo_file: River Street, Maclean, New South Wales, 2021, 21.jpg

members.name: Iluka
members.bio: Small beachside village across the Clarence River from Yamba, reached by shuttle ferry or the motorway.

members.name: Iluka Nature Reserve
members.bio: World Heritage littoral rainforest, the largest remaining stand in NSW, home to over 140 bird species.

members.name: Silverton
members.bio: Mining ghost town 26 km from Broken Hill, where Mad Max 2 was filmed, with art galleries.

members.name: Mundi Mundi Lookout
members.bio: Lookout just west of Silverton over the Mundi Mundi plain, a favourite sunset spot.

members.name: Pro Hart Gallery and Sculpture Park
members.bio: Gallery of artist Pro Hart's paintings and sculptures, including the Rolls-Royce he painted.

members.name: Line of Lode Miners Memorial
members.bio: Memorial on a mullock heap naming each miner who died on glass panels, with views over town.
members.photo_file: Line of Lode Miner's Memorial, Broken Hill, NSW, 07.07.2007.jpg

members.name: Silverton Mad Max 2 Museum
members.bio: Museum of props, behind-the-scenes photos and original and replica vehicles from Mad Max 2.
members.hours: Wed–Sat 10:00 AM – 4:00 PM; Sun 11:00 AM – 3:00 PM; closed Mon–Tue

members.name: Royal Flying Doctor Outback Heritage Experience
members.bio: Heritage visit at the Flying Doctor's Broken Hill base, beside the airport terminal.
members.hours: Mon–Fri 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM; Sat–Sun 10:00 AM – 4:00 PM

members.name: Living Desert Sculptures
members.bio: Twelve sandstone sculptures on Sundown Hill, in a 180-hectare sanctuary, 900 m walk from the car park.
members.hours: Dec–Feb 6:00 AM to half an hour after sunset; other months 8:30 AM to half an hour after sunset

members.name: Daydream Mine
members.bio: Historic mine 28 km north-west of Broken Hill, with underground and surface tours at 10:00 and 11:30 am.
members.hours: Tours 10:00 AM and 11:30 AM; Tue–Thu, Sat–Sun in quiet months, daily in school holidays (book ahead)

members.name: Lightning Ridge Bore Baths
members.bio: Free artesian pools of warm water from about 900 m underground, open around the clock.

members.name: The Big Opal
members.bio: Self-guided tour 30 m underground through three dug tunnels with an opal seam, about 45 minutes.

members.name: Lightning Ridge Bottle House
members.bio: House built of bottles, now the Bottle House and Mining Museum on Opal Street.

members.name: Menindee Lakes
members.bio: Chain of Darling River lakes near Menindee that fill only after months of rain in southern Queensland.

members.name: Kinchega Woolshed
members.bio: An 1875 woolshed of corrugated iron and river red gum where six million sheep were sheared in 97 years.
members.hours: Park open daily; woolshed tours in Easter, winter and spring school holidays

members.name: Brewarrina Aboriginal Fish Traps
members.bio: Baiame's Ngunnhu, heritage-registered stone fish traps stretching about 500 m along the Barwon riverbed.
members.hours: Daylight hours; guided tours from the museum (times unverified)

members.name: Brewarrina Aboriginal Culture Museum
members.bio: Museum overlooking the fish traps, with local artefacts, language and fossils and an Aboriginal gift shop.

members.name: Wagga Wagga Botanic Gardens
members.bio: Gardens from 1961 with a rainforest gully, succulent garden, free zoo and aviary, and a miniature railway.
members.hours: Open daily (zoo and aviary Thursday to Monday 9:00 AM – 4:00 PM)

members.name: Wiradjuri Walking Track
members.bio: About 42 km of track circling much of Wagga Wagga, with river, hilltop and city views.
